t: Sheyyepayyes adam et chabero beereb yom kippur
s: Sheyyepayyes adam et chabero beereb yom kippur ubo y"d seipim: abera shebben adam lachabero — en yom hakkippurim mekapper ad sheyyeratztzeh et chabero, shenneemar "ki bayyom hazzeh yekapper alekem letaher etkem mikkol chattotekem lipne Hashem go'", kelomar "chattotekem" shehem "lipne Hashem" lebad yom hakkippurim mekapper, abal mah shebben adam lachabero en yom hakkippurim mekapper ad sheyyepayyesennu. Lepikak yitten kol adam el libbo beereb yom hakkippurim lepayyes lekol mi sheppasha kenegdo, vaapillu lo hiqnito ella bidbarim — tzarik lelek ulepayyeso ulebaqqesh mimmennu sheyyimchol lo, ubishat baqqashat mechila tzarik leparet hachete shechata lachabero. Veim chabero mitbayyesh bazeh — lo yeparet hachete:

Veim eno mitpayyes bepaam rishon — yachazor veyelek lepayyeso paam shenit bemin ritztzuy acher, veim lo nitpayyes — yachazor veyelek paam shelishit lepayyeso bemin ritztzuy acher. Ubekol paam sheholek lepayyeso apillu bappaam harishon — yiqqach immo shelosha anashim vipayyesennu bipnehem. Veim lo nitpayyes bappaam hashshelishit — shub en zaquq lo, umikkol maqom tzarik lehodia larabbim dehaynu asara anashim shehu halak lepayyeso velo ratza lehitpayyes, kede shello yachsheduhu habberiyyot shello ratza lehaknia et atzmo lipne chabero lebaqqesh mimmennu mechila:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshehiqnit et chabero, abal im hiqnit et rabbo, apillu eno rabbo mubhaq raq sheshshama mimmennu dibre tora — tzarik lelek elayv kamma peamim ad sheyyitpayyes. Vaapillu keshehiqnit et chabero, im rotzeh lehachamir al atzmo velelek elayv kamma peamim — hareshut beyado, ubilbad shello yihyeh sham bizyon tora:

Vehammochel lo yihyeh akzari millimchol ella yimchol lo miyyad, ella im ken hu mitkavven letobat hambaqqesh mechila kede sheyyikkana lebabo hearel, o shechoshesh shello yabo lo leatzmo ezeh raa al yede sheyyimchol lo, deaz eno tzarik limchol lo, dechayyayv qodemin lechayye chabero. Veim hotzi alayv shem ra — eno tzarik limchol lo bekol inyan, apillu im yebaqqesh mimmennu kamma peamim, mishshum deepshar sheyyesh bene adam sheshshameu hotzaat hallaaz alayv velo shameu happiyyus veyidmeh lahem sheepshar shehallaaz hu emet velo yatza adayin adam zeh naqi mechashad, umikkol maqom middat anava limchol apillu behotzaat shem ra:

Veim met mi sheppasha kenegdo — mebi asara bene adam umaamidam al qibro veomer bipnehem "chatati lelohe yisrael veliploni zeh sheppashati kenegdo". Vetzarik sheyyelek lesham yachep. Veim hu chutz leshalosh parsaot min qibro — eno tzarik lelek beatzmo lesham, ella yishlach shelucho sheyyebaqqesh mimmennu mechila baabur hashsholecho bipne asara bene adam:
Vaapillu hotzi alayv shem ra bechayyayv — moil mah sheyyebaqqesh mimmennu bipne asara bene adam, mishshum sheanu omedin dato shel hammet demin hassetam illu haya qayyam haya mochel lo:
Veim cherepo leachar mita — eno tzarik lelek al qibro, ella mebaqqesh mimmennu mechila bammaqom shebbiyyesho:

Ap al pi shebbekol hashshana rauy lekol adam lepayyes tekep lemi sheppasha kenegdo, mikkol maqom beereb yom hakkippurim tzarik lizzaher bazeh beyoter, kede sheyyihyeh leb kol yisrael shalem zeh im zeh velo yehe maqom lassatan leqatreg alehem:
Taqqanot qadmonim vecherem shello lehotzi shem ra al hammetim:
Mi sheqqara lachabero mamzer — lo pagam bikbod abotayv, sheyyakol lomar eleka lebad nitkavvanti lebazzoteka, ella im ken qerao mamzer ben mamzer:

Nohagin litbol beereb yom hakkippurim. Veyesh omerim shettaam tebila zo hu mishshum qeri, kede sheyyihyu neqiyyim utehorim beyom hakkippurim, ulepi taam zeh en inyan kelal lomar vidduyim bammiqveh, veken en tzarik litbol ella paam achat. Umi shettabal beereb rosh hashshana velo raa qeri achar kak — ap al pi ken tzarik litbol beereb yom hakkippurim, deshemma raa achar kak mayim chaluqim o akurim, sheharoeh otan tame mishshum baal qeri. Utebila zo shehi mishshum qeri keshera apillu bearbaim sea sheubim keshehem baqqarqa, abal lo bikli. Umi shehu mitztaer bitbila — yakol lishpok alayv tisha qabbin mayim. Verashshay lishpok alayv mishshenayim o mishshelosha kelim zeh achar zeh uben kullam yihyeh tisha qabbin, ubilbad sheyyatchil hashsheni ad shello pasaq harishon veken hashshelishi ad shello pasaq hashsheni. Abal mearbaa kelim — en mitztorpin letisha qabbin. Vaapillu im memareq mikkeli echad — yizzaher lehariq belo hapsaqa kelal. Veim niknas chetzyo letok hammiqveh veal chetzyo shapeku t' qabbin — yatza. Veishsha sheshshimmesha tok shelosha yamim litbila zo — tzerika lekabbed betah bechammin qodem shettitbol, kede lehaplit kol hashshikbat zera shebbimqorah, shello taplit achar hattebila utehe temea beyom hakkippurim — ayyen beyoreh dea siman qtz"v. Veim shimmesha samuk litbilatah o samuk levistah, shebbeellu hazzemannim hi regila lehitabber — lo tekabbed betah bechammin, shemma tashchit zera haherayon, lepikak enah tzerika litbol kelal beereb yom hakkippurim:

Abal yesh omerim shettaam tebila zo hu mishshum teshuba, keger hammitgayyer. Ulepi zeh yesh litbol shalosh peamim. Vaapillu nearim ubetulot shehem bene mitzva nohagim litbol, ap al pi sheen qeri shayyak bahen. Vaapillu mi shettabal beereb rosh hashshana velo raa qeri achar kak — tzarik lachazor velitbol beereb yom hakkippurim mishshum teshuba:
Yesh litbol qodem tepillat mincha, kede lehitvaddot (bemincha) betohora. Veyesh tobelin achar seuda hammapseqet, kede sheyyehe samuk leyom hakkippurim:

Mi shemmet lo met qodem yom hakkippurim — muttar lo lirchotz bechammin velitbol beereb yom hakkippurim, mippene sheyyom hakkippurim dino korgalim shemmebattelim mimmennu gezerat shiba kemo shennitbaer besiman tqm"ch, ella deyesh lo leacher harechitza vehattebila kol mah sheepshar sheyyihyu samuk lachasheka mittaam shennitbaer sham. Ushear dine abelut kegon yeshiba al gabbe qarqa — tzarik linhog ad hallayla mammash, mittaam shennitbaer sham:
